result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a navigation state inconsistency, a truncated restaurant name in a horizontal scroll, and a card cut off at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar highlights 'Profile' as the active tab, but the content shown is the Home feed, creating a mismatched UI state.
issues.suggestion: Synchronize the active tab indicator with the currently displayed screen; highlight 'Home' when the home feed is visible.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is cut off at the right edge, and the restaurant name appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding to the horizontal scroll container and ensure card widths or text handling allow the full restaurant name to be readable.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off by the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or scroll margin so the last card is fully visible, or ensure the cut-off clearly signals additional scrollable content.
